title: Product of Walsh characters
statement:
For any two subsets $S, T \subseteq [n]$ and any point $x \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \chi_S(x)\,\chi_T(x) = \chi_{S \mathbin{\triangle} T}(x),
\]
where $\chi_S$ denotes the Walsh--Fourier character of $S$ and $S \mathbin{\triangle} T$ is the symmetric difference of $S$ and $T$.
hypotheses_covered: x a point of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
replaced:
For all $S, T \subseteq [n]$ and $x \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \chi_S(x)\,\chi_T(x) = \chi_{S \mathbin{\triangle} T}(x),
\]
where $S \mathbin{\triangle} T$ denotes the symmetric difference.
